notes.title: Listen Me joins the Steam Puzzle Fest!
notes.content:
Get ready to celebrate the puzzle-solving spirit with the Steam Puzzle Fest! This festival includes amazing discounts, unreleased games, and game demos that will keep you engaged.

And guess what? Listen Me is taking part in the Steam Puzzle Fest too! You can now grab the game at a [b]discounted rate of 25%.[/b] Make sure you don't miss this opportunity and get your hands on Listen Me before [b]May 1st at 10:00 AM PDT.[/b]

notes.title: Fixed bug and Update Features
notes.content:
[u][b]New[/b][/u]
- Alarm is set when the time limit is less than 5 minutes.
- More in-game sounds.
- Player notification UI.
- A new random environment.

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
- Fixed a bug where clocks sometimes don't spawn in the puzzle rooms.
- Catching a banana man doll can now increase the time.
- Fixed block object and player scaling.
